important_correction: flash_crucible_resume_runtime evidence incorrectly assigns the readiness-byte write to OnRep_ParticipantBestTimes; the write is in OnRep_CurrentControlType.

onrep_current.effect: If GetWorld() exists, set byte +0x4f1 true and broadcast no-argument delegate at +0x280.

onrep_best_times.effect: If GetWorld() exists, broadcast same no-argument delegate; does not write byte +0x4f1.

delegate: Reflected offset 0x280 is OnCrucibleParticipantBestTimesUpdated, declared FCrucibleParticipantBestTimesUpdated; helper 0x1406a9dc0 traverses copied dynamic multicast script delegates and invokes ProcessEvent.

platform_predicates.comparison: 0x142bcf780 compares ASCII case-insensitively; non-ASCII mismatches compare by raw UTF-16 units. Empty string compares as empty.
platform_predicates.caveat: Proposal uses explicit ASCII folding to match the original comparison of these ASCII codes, including non-ASCII mismatches.

getter_observation: GetParticipantBestTimeCurrentControlState computes index in uint8, correctly wrapping modulo 256 before bounds check.
initialization: Original constructor 0x141ac01c0 sets +0x4f1 false. Proposed member has no in-class initializer because generator member_field parser does not accept one; UE object allocation must provide zero initialization, including construction paths.
validation: No build or tests per assignment; source is an isolated proposal.
no_world: Both OnReps return without changes or broadcast when GetWorld() is null. GetCurrentControlState returns CurrentControlType if world missing, role is authority, readiness flag is true, first player controller is absent/wrong type, or Athena player state absent/wrong type.
player_state_type: 0x141680740 tests player state against 0x142a8ae70, FortPlayerStateAthena StaticClass.
